one_liner: Ahrefs offers a REST API with API keys and OAuth for third-party integrations.
gating_notes: API keys are free to generate for public endpoints, but full API access requires an eligible paid plan. Ahrefs Connect (OAuth) requires app approval.
oauth_details: Ahrefs Connect uses OAuth for third-party apps to access data on behalf of users. Requires app submission and approval.

auth_methods.quote: You'll need an API key to send requests via Ahrefs API v3. Provide it in the Authorization header when making requests: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.
